rationale: The Chief is likely to keep assignment to himself or to Justice Kagan to produce a narrow, administrable opinion enforcing the statutory text (reasonable/allowable/allocable, non-duplicative CSC) without adopting a Secretarial-amount cap. Justice Alito is very likely to write a lone dissent focused on appropriations/clear-statement concerns, with a meaningful chance of a separate concurrence from Justice Gorsuch (and possibly Barrett/Thomas) emphasizing ISDEAA’s liberal-construction rule and anti-atextual limits.
